en: This is a black-and-white postcard image depicting a large historic building complex with traditional European architecture. The central building has a steeply pitched roof with dormer windows, a small tower or cupola, and an arched entryway. On the left, another building is visible, connected by a covered wooden bridge. The area in front appears to be a courtyard with a well or stone structure in the center. The photo has an old, early 20th-century or late 19th-century aesthetic. In the top left corner, the text 'Klipp­hausen — Schloss' is printed.
